## Change

What changed, and which demo or component does it affect?

## Verification

- Commands run and outcomes (include failures):
- Scenario, seed, people count, policy/profile and artifact path for live runs:
- Any change to perception/oracle inputs, goal criteria or scoring:

## Handoff checks

- [ ] Maintained docs and CLI examples match the implementation.
- [ ] Generated diagrams/media are current and clearly labelled.
- [ ] Patched submodule changes were exported and `verify-pristine` passed.
- [ ] No credentials, generated build trees, private checkpoints or raw runtime logs are staged.
- [ ] New dependencies and remaining limitations are documented.
